import copy, hashlib, json
APPROVED_CAP_ADD = frozenset({"CAP_CHOWN", "CAP_FOWNER", "CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE"})
def canonical_hostconfig_capadd(value):
    assert type(value) is dict and "CapAdd" in value
    caps = value["CapAdd"]
    assert type(caps) is list and len(caps) == 3
    assert all(type(cap) is str for cap in caps)
    assert len(set(caps)) == 3 and set(caps) == APPROVED_CAP_ADD
    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
    result["CapAdd"] = sorted(caps)
    # No other array, field, value or type is discarded or reordered.
    return json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                      ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
def compare_complete_hostconfig_capadd(expected, actual):
    left = canonical_hostconfig_capadd(expected)
    right = canonical_hostconfig_capadd(actual)
    assert left == right
    return hashlib.sha256(left).hexdigest()

EXPECTED_ENGINE_CONTEXT = {"server_version": "28.5.2+dfsg4",
    "server_git_commit": "3ef3c07c883be49a2e8097bcf6d2952fce1d70eb",
    "server_api_version": "1.51", "storage_driver": "overlay2",
    "cgroup_version": "2", "oom_kill_disable_supported": False}
def compare_phase_hostconfig(validated_created, observed, phase, engine_context):
    encode = lambda value: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                                     ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
    assert encode(engine_context) == encode(EXPECTED_ENGINE_CONTEXT)
    assert type(validated_created) is dict and type(observed) is dict
    assert "OomKillDisable" in validated_created and "OomKillDisable" in observed
    assert validated_created["OomKillDisable"] is False
    if phase == "created":
        assert observed["OomKillDisable"] is False
    elif phase == "stopped":
        assert observed["OomKillDisable"] is None
    else:
        raise AssertionError("unknown inspection phase")
    # Copy only after phase/engine/type/field checks; retain original raw false/null records.
    comparison = copy.deepcopy(observed)
    comparison["OomKillDisable"] = False
    return compare_complete_hostconfig_capadd(validated_created, comparison)

busybox_trigger.body:
#!/bin/busybox sh

do_bb_install=

for i in "$@"; do
	case "$i" in
		/lib/modules/* | /usr/lib/modules/*)
			# don't run busybox depmod if we have kmod installed
			# we dont need to run it twice.
			target=$(readlink -f "$(command -v depmod || true)")
			if [ -d "$i" ] && [ "$target" = "/bin/busybox" ]; then
				/bin/busybox depmod ${i#*/lib/modules/}
			fi
			;;
		*) do_bb_install=yes;;
	esac
done

if [ -n "$do_bb_install" ]; then
	[ -e /bin/bbsuid ] && /bin/bbsuid --install
	[ -e /bin/busybox-extras ] && /bin/busybox-extras --install -s
	/bin/busybox --install -s
fi

#!/bin/sh

# we need to have our modprobe.d files with .conf suffix
for i in etc/modprobe.d/*; do
	# ignore files that does not exist (i.e if modprobe.d is empty)
	[ -r "$i" ] || continue

	# ignore files that have an extension
	case "$i" in
		*.*) continue;;
	esac

	# append extension
	mv "$i" "$i".conf
done

# migrate /var/run directory to /run
if [ -d var/run ] && [ ! -L var/run ]; then
	cp -a var/run/* run 2>/dev/null
	rm -rf var/run
	ln -s ../run var/run
fi

# migrate /var/lock directory to /run/lock
if [ -d var/lock ] && [ ! -L var/lock ]; then
	mkdir -p run/lock/subsys
	cp -a var/lock/* run/lock 2>/dev/null
	rm -rf var/lock
	ln -s ../run/lock var/lock
fi

# migrate /var/spool/mail directory to /var/mail
if [ -d var/spool/mail ] && [ ! -L var/spool/mail ]; then
	mkdir -p var/mail
	cp -a var/spool/mail/* var/mail/ 2>/dev/null
	rm -rf var/spool/mail
	ln -s ../mail var/spool/mail
fi
addgroup -S -g 42 shadow 2>/dev/null

exit 0

#!/bin/busybox sh

# remove links that has been relocated or removed
# - generate a list of all symlinks in bin dirs and a list with all busybox
#   applets
# - sort the list and print all lines that are unique. This is the list of
#   symlinks that does not exist in the busybox applets list.
# - use stat to find the target of those symlinks printed as:
#     '/path/to/symlink' -> '/path/to/target'
#   The "2>/dev/null" is used to stop "can't stat" warnings appearing on
#   the console for each new command added by the new version of the
#   busybox package.
# - use awk to print the symlinks that points to '/bin/busybox'
# - use sed to strip the leading and training ' chars
# - finally pass the list to rm for removing the symlinks that points to
#   busybox but does not exist in the `busybox --list-all` list. On /usr-merged
#   systems find duplicates some of the symlinks, so pass -f to silence the
#   errors.
#   TODO: remove the -f flag after busybox is installed solely under /usr,
#   see #17423 and #17642
{ find bin sbin usr/bin usr/sbin -maxdepth 1 -type l; busybox --list-all; } \
	| sort | uniq -u \
	| xargs -r stat -c "%N" 2>/dev/null \
	| awk "\$3 == \"'/bin/busybox'\" {print \$1}" \
	| sed "s/^'//; s/'$//" \
	| xargs -r rm -f

for link in /bin/ping /bin/ping6; do
	if [ -L "$link" ] && [ "$(readlink $link)" = "/bin/bbsuid" ]; then
		rm "$link"
	fi
done

# We need the symlinks early
/bin/busybox --install -s || exit 1

# can't be in pre-upgrade since adduser/group may not available then
addgroup -S klogd 2>/dev/null
adduser -S -D -H -h /dev/null -s /sbin/nologin -G klogd -g klogd klogd 2>/dev/null

exit 0

#!/bin/busybox sh

do_bb_install=

for i in "$@"; do
	case "$i" in
		/lib/modules/* | /usr/lib/modules/*)
			# don't run busybox depmod if we have kmod installed
			# we dont need to run it twice.
			target=$(readlink -f "$(command -v depmod || true)")
			if [ -d "$i" ] && [ "$target" = "/bin/busybox" ]; then
				/bin/busybox depmod ${i#*/lib/modules/}
			fi
			;;
		*) do_bb_install=yes;;
	esac
done

if [ -n "$do_bb_install" ]; then
	[ -e /bin/bbsuid ] && /bin/bbsuid --install
	[ -e /bin/busybox-extras ] && /bin/busybox-extras --install -s
	/bin/busybox --install -s
fi

def physical_headers_stream(stream,size,cap,magic=(b'ustar\0'+b'00')):

    # otherwise consumes GNU L/K and PAX x/g without yielding those headers.

            while True:
                remaining=stream.read(65536)

            assert headers

        # other unsupported physical type BEFORE it can affect parsing.
        kind=block[156:157];assert kind in (b'0',b'1',b'2',b'5')
        assert block[257:265]==magic

def bounded_audit(function,*args):
    # The exact host audit runs in the supervisor's main Python thread on Linux.
    # This is read-only parsing; timeout is a hard failed receipt, never partial.
    import signal, time
    assert signal.getitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL)==(0.0,0.0)
    previous=signal.getsignal(signal.SIGALRM)
    def expired(signum,frame):raise TimeoutError('complete host audit exceeded60s')
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,expired);signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,60.0)
    try:return function(*args)
    finally:
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,0.0);signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,previous)
